evals.name: Revoke unlocks through the workflow, never by hand
evals.prompt: Use the intent-lock skill to revoke the intent 'label-reprint'. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents) and repoDir is intents-root/repo. The board says its Status is Plan and the PM has already confirmed they want it back. GitHub and git are unavailable, so skip steps 1-2, R2 and R4, and instead of running anything in R3 write the exact commands you would run, plus a one-paragraph summary of the revoke, to revoke-report.md.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: The report dispatches the intent-lock workflow for issue 7 and waits for it instead of deleting intent.lock itself.
The summary says the intent moves back to Create and can be edited again with /intent-sync.
